title: Complete webhook signature coverage
owaspMappings: OWASP API10:2023 Unsafe Consumption of APIs
summary: A verifier authenticates selected metadata while later processing body fields that are not cryptographically bound.
securityInvariant: Every message component that influences business processing or routing must be covered directly or through a verified digest bound into the signature.
visibleBehavior: A matching signed body is accepted.
securityOracle: A changed business value is rejected.
An added destination field is rejected.
An added tenant-routing field is rejected.
A modified signed digest is rejected.

variants.vulnerable: Checks signed headers but never compares the body to the signed digest.
variants.naive: Recomputes a digest over selected business fields while ignoring newly introduced routing fields.
variants.reference: Verifies signed metadata and the digest of the exact raw body before parsing.

safeUse: Synthetic local benchmark only; never test systems without explicit authorization.
